q: Weather and TV satellites usually use which orbit?
x: A geostationary satellite stays over the same spot, so dishes don't need to move.

q: Who was the first Indian to go to the International Space Station?
x: Shubhanshu Shukla, on Axiom-4 in 2025. Rakesh Sharma (1984) went to the Soviet Salyut-7 station.
LVM3 (earlier called GSLV Mk III) launched it on 14 July 2023.

q: National Space Day is observed on…
x: 23 August, when Chandrayaan-3 landed near the Moon's south pole in 2023.
Aedes spreads dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Anopheles spreads malaria; Culex spreads filaria and Japanese encephalitis.

q: Lack of which vitamin causes scurvy?
x: Vitamin C. D → rickets, B1 → beriberi, A → night blindness.

q: Who discovered the germ that causes tuberculosis?
x: Robert Koch, 1882. 24 March is World TB Day.
LPG = propane + butane. CNG is mainly methane.

o: C.V. Raman's discovery of the Raman effect
x: Raman announced the effect on 28 February 1928.
A scramjet needs air coming in at very high speed, so it works above Mach 5.

q: Which mission made India the fourth country to dock two satellites in space?
x: SpaDeX (Space Docking Experiment), docked in January 2025, after the USA, Russia and China.

q: Who is the father of the Indian space programme?
x: Vikram Sarabhai founded ISRO's forerunner INCOSPAR. Bhabha is the father of India's nuclear programme.
